name: The St Regis Mardavall Mallorca Resort
insider_take: This clifftop sanctuary seamlessly blends Mallorcan heritage with St. Regis luxury, where every sunset feels like a private performance over the Mediterranean.
whats_special: The resort sits on a dramatic clifftop in Costa d'en Blanes, offering unobstructed views of the Bay of Palma. The property features authentic Mallorcan stone architecture and houses one of the island's most acclaimed restaurants, Es Fum, which holds a Michelin star. The signature St. Regis Butler Service ensures personalized attention, from unpacking to arranging private yacht excursions.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at the outdoor terrace of Es Fum during summer months – the restaurant's floor-to-ceiling windows retract completely, creating an open-air dining experience with panoramic sea views.
dont_miss: The resort's infinity pool appears to merge with the Mediterranean horizon, creating Instagram-worthy shots. Take the complimentary shuttle to nearby Puerto Portals marina, where superyachts dock alongside high-end boutiques. The spa's signature Mallorcan Sea Salt treatment uses locally harvested salt from the island's ancient salt flats in Es Trenc.
pros: Stunning clifftop location with panoramic Mediterranean views
Exceptional St. Regis butler service and personalized attention
Award-winning spa with comprehensive wellness facilities
Multiple dining venues including Michelin-starred Es Fum restaurant
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive positioning
Secluded location requires transportation to explore Mallorca
